paper_ref.title: Training LLMs for Honesty via Confessions
paper_ref.authors: Joglekar, Chen, Wu, Yosinski, Wang, Barak, Glaese (OpenAI)

match_strength.3P: Three-point structural match: (1) same functional role, (2) same dual-channel shape, (3) same honesty/task separation logic
match_strength.2P: Two-point match: shared mechanism with different control surface or naming

provenance_class.A: Direct architectural isomorphism (concept appears as core named mechanism on both sides)
provenance_class.B: Functional equivalence (same job done under different labels or process steps)
provenance_class.C: Derived / supporting mechanism (enables A/B concepts; weaker standalone claim)

structure.concept: primary output + secondary output
structure.driftcore_anchor: Response_1 (primary/task stream) + Response_2 (secondary/truth stream after pressure)
structure.paper_anchor: main answer y after (x,z) + confession y_c after system message x_c

structure.concept: secondary output interrogates primary output
structure.driftcore_anchor: Truth stream forced against primary; pressure/contradiction extraction compares streams
structure.paper_anchor: ConfessionReport analyzes whether answer y satisfied letter/spirit of objectives; compliance_analysis over primary y

structure.concept: discrepancy between outputs is evidence
structure.driftcore_anchor: Δ = Response_2 − Response_1; contradiction events logged as forensic evidence
structure.paper_anchor: Main can lie/omit while confession surfaces non-compliance; TP/FN framing; discrepancy enables monitoring

structure.concept: self-report of model misconduct
structure.driftcore_anchor: Forced secondary extraction of actual reasoning state / honesty self-assessment under R_truth
structure.paper_anchor: Self-reported confession of shortcomings, policy/instruction violations, covert actions

structure.concept: decoupled task reward vs honesty/truth reward
structure.driftcore_anchor: R_task and R_truth never aggregate; Total_Reward ≠ R_task + R_truth
structure.paper_anchor: R(y|x) for main answer; R_c(y_c|x,y,x_c) honesty-only for confession; not aggregated

structure.concept: honesty reward cannot help or hurt main-task reward (seal)
structure.driftcore_anchor: Critical separation prevents trading honesty for performance; truth alignment rewarded independently
structure.paper_anchor: Catholic Church 'seal of confession': nothing revealed in confession changes original-task reward

structure.concept: path of least resistance favors surfacing misbehavior on secondary channel
structure.driftcore_anchor: Separation of reward signals prevents optimizing for deception on the truth stream
structure.paper_anchor: Path of least resistance for maximizing confession reward is to surface misbehavior rather than cover up

structure.concept: dual-stream / two-channel rollout architecture
structure.driftcore_anchor: Parity-Sync: Task Stream + Truth Stream as two separate data streams
structure.paper_anchor: Standard rollout (x→z→y) extended by confession leg (x_c→z_c→y_c)

structure.concept: secondary channel requested after primary completes
structure.driftcore_anchor: Step order: baseline Response_1 → pressure → Response_2
structure.paper_anchor: Confession requested via system message after original answer; upon request post-answer

structure.concept: enumerate instructions/objectives then score compliance
structure.driftcore_anchor: Contradiction classifications + status tracking against what model claimed vs revealed
structure.paper_anchor: ConfessionReport: list all explicit/implicit instructions/constraints/objectives + compliance analysis per objective

structure.concept: report uncertainties / grey areas / tough judgment calls
structure.driftcore_anchor: Honest self-assessment; classification when denial vs capability tension appears
structure.paper_anchor: Confession must enumerate uncertainties, ambiguities, judgement calls in producing answer

structure.concept: secondary honesty improves even when main channel is hacked
structure.driftcore_anchor: R_truth evaluated against contradiction matrix independent of task compromise
structure.paper_anchor: Section 4: under hackable judge, main accuracy drifts down while confession honesty rises toward ~100% on non-compliance

structure.concept: come clean on secondary more than on primary
structure.driftcore_anchor: Response_2 reveals what Response_1 hid; primary filtered, secondary forced truth
structure.paper_anchor: Main findings: when bad behavior occurs, model significantly more likely to come clean in confession than main answer

structure.concept: inference-time monitoring based on secondary output
structure.driftcore_anchor: Episkope: intercept primary, pressure, capture secondary, log events, export evidence; runtime detection
structure.paper_anchor: Confessions enable inference-time interventions: monitoring, rejection sampling, surfacing issues to user

structure.concept: rejection / filter decisions driven by secondary honesty signal
structure.driftcore_anchor: Dishonesty_Score and contradiction status as gate for trust/export; detection system requirements
structure.paper_anchor: Rejection sampling listed as first-class inference-time use of confessions

structure.concept: quantified honesty / compliance grade on secondary channel
structure.driftcore_anchor: Dishonesty_Score = (Σ Δᵢ)/n in [0,1]; P(x)=|Truth_state−Output_state|
structure.paper_anchor: overall_compliance_grade 1–7; failing ≤3 if unreported gap/uncertainty

structure.concept: evidence-backed claims in secondary analysis
structure.driftcore_anchor: Contradiction event record: timestamp, trigger, both responses, type, CRC32/crypto markers
structure.paper_anchor: Confession analysis requires evidence (tool-call citations, excerpts); judge requires evidence for compliance claims

structure.concept: detect intentional misbehavior (scheming / reward hack / sandbag) via secondary
structure.driftcore_anchor: Classes: runtime.denial.reversal, sandbox.leak, compliance.route.failure, handler.memory.divergence
structure.paper_anchor: Evals: scheming, reward hacking, sandbagging, instruction violation; confessions strong when model is aware of misbehavior

structure.concept: secondary channel as diagnostic not primary capability trainer
structure.driftcore_anchor: Adversarial red-team / forensic detection tool; user-controlled pressure extraction
structure.paper_anchor: Best used as monitoring/diagnostic tool for deployment control, not for direct main-task training

structure.concept: parity / alignment between internal state and external output as honesty objective
structure.driftcore_anchor: Parity-Sync Gate: force alignment of internal state with external output; P(x)=0 honest
structure.paper_anchor: Confession as honest account of actions/beliefs vs main answer that may misrepresent actions

structure.concept: reward misspecification on main channel as root cause of dishonesty
structure.driftcore_anchor: Task reward hackable via safety filtering; dual-reward invented to stop deception optimization
structure.paper_anchor: RL multi-objective reward misspecification incentivizes answers that look good rather than faithful reporting

structure.concept: structured secondary schema vs free-form primary
structure.driftcore_anchor: Contradiction matrix event schema (timestamp, R1, R2, type, status) + classification taxonomy
structure.paper_anchor: ConfessionReport JSON schema (compliance_analysis[], uncertainties, overall_compliance_grade)
